While a <solar/>Solar Super is equipped and fully charged, ability kills (including Unpowered Melees) grant <solar/>Cure x2 and stacks of 'Sunfire Furnace' <link based on Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />. Minor Tier enemies grant 1 stack, while Elite and Higher tier enemies grant 2. Stacks last for 20 seconds. Maximum of 10 stacks.

While Sunfire Furnace is active, kills with <solar/>Shieldburst or <bold ANY /> Grenade triggers an <solar/>Ignition (even <yellow Forerunner's /> 'The Rock').

Sunfire Furnace also grants Increased Super Damage and Additional Base Grenade and Class Ability Regneration rate at 1|2|3... stacks.
• 6.5%|13.6%|22%|32%|43%|57%|73%|93%|118%|150%| Increased Super Damage
• ?|?|?|?|?|?|?|?|?|250% Base Grenade and Class Ability Regeneration

Casting your Super locks all stacks. Refund 8%|20%|26%|33%|45% Super Energy at 1|2|3|4|5+ stacks of Sunfire Furnace after your super ends.
